trap.label: gerúndio/preposição
trap.wrong: I had trouble to set it up.
trap.right: I had trouble setting it up.
trap.why: Em português “tive dificuldade em/para configurar”, e o brasileiro usa to + verbo. Em inglês: have trouble + -ing.

mcq.q: Tive problema com o app = I had trouble **___** the app.

fix.wrong: We had trouble to find the room.
fix.right: We had trouble finding the room.

fix.wrong: He has difficulty to speak fast.

fix.why: Depois de trouble usa-se -ing, não particípio.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com had trouble: “I couldn’t set it up.” (setting)
rewrite.answer: I had trouble setting it up.

rewrite.prompt: Use have difficulty: “She finds it hard to read.” (reading)
